method: premium_pct = (parallel buying midpoint / CBN selling rate - 1) x 100; withheld where fewer than two independent current observations were verified
parallel_source: Aggregated from multiple independent market sources
official_sources: Central Bank of Nigeria and national official reference tables
nigeria_market_note: Nigeria parallel-market buy/sell ranges, midpoints and premiums are withheld this edition: fewer than two independent current observations could be verified. CBN benchmark rates are those of 14 Oct (15 Oct not yet posted). Aggregated from multiple independent market sources.
nigeria_market_note_short: Parallel ranges withheld: insufficient independent verification.
markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana mid of Bank of Ghana buy/sell (14 Oct); Kenya CBK commercial-banks’ average closing rates (market close 14 Oct; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates (14 Oct, carried forward; SARB endpoint unreachable this run); Egypt mid of CBE buy/sell (14 Oct).
